title: Aurora in the 1986 budget

tellings.quote: There's a 1968, or sorry, 1986 budget, uh where it shows up as a line item for I think it like $2 billion or something

plain: Michels says that Aurora, a name tied to a rumoured secret American aircraft project, shows up as a line item in the 1986 United States budget, for something like 2 billion dollars, he thinks (he first says 1968, then corrects himself). He tells it himself, mentioning the aerospace engineer Ben Rich and documents from Britain's Ministry of Defence, its defence department. If true, it would mean a secret aircraft project left a trace in the public budget.
